name: publish_game
description: Publish a deployed game to the Higgsfield marketplace. This does not deploy anything: the game must already be live — use deploy_game first, then pass the game id from its response. The catalog card image comes from the deploy by default; cover (16:9) and logo (1:1 square) optionally override it — when given they must be https image URLs from generate_image (a stable CDN link, never the game's own site URL). Publishing lists the game publicly on the marketplace (ownership-checked against the authenticated user); re-publish updates the same listing.

game_id.description: UUID of the deployed game to publish to the marketplace, as returned by the deploy flow.

cover.description: Optional override: https URL of a 16:9 catalog cover from generate_image (CDN link, not the game's own site). Omit to keep the deploy-set cover.

logo.description: Optional override: https URL of a 1:1 square catalog icon from generate_image (CDN link, not the game's own site). Omit to keep the deploy-set icon.

name.description: Optional catalog name override; defaults to the deployed title.
